title: Permissions and clipboard
description: Use a user-triggered clipboard action, handle denied or unsupported capabilities and provide an accessible manual-copy fallback.
objectives: Request clipboard writing only after an explicit user action
Handle unsupported or denied API access as normal behavior
Provide manual-copy fallback without misleading success
rubric: I attempted a capability only from an explicit user action.
I tested the unsupported or denied path without false success feedback.
I kept the sample synthetic and available for manual copying.
